outcome: incision site healing (Redness, Edema, Ecchymosis, Discharge, and Approximation Scale)
cohort: The study included 138 women who gave birth by cesarean between January and September 2023, divided into TENS, placebo, and control groups.
finding: TENS application significantly improved postoperative recovery and postpartum comfort compared to placebo and control groups after cesarean birth.
mod_finding: TENS application was found to be an effective alternative method to increase pain control, recovery, and patient comfort specifically after cesarean birth.
followup_time: Early postpartum period (interventions at 10-12 and 14-16 hours after birth, outcomes measured postintervention)
